description: This file defines the MappingOutcome interface and related classes/interfaces for representing the result of message mapping operations in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating outcomes like mapped, dropped, or error states, and defines a visitor pattern for handling these outcomes.

classes.name: MappingOutcome
classes.description: An interface representing the outcome of inbound and outbound message mapping operations, including static methods for creating different outcome types and nested interfaces/classes for visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.Visitor
classes.description: An interface for visitors to handle different mapping outcomes (mapped, dropped, error).

classes.name: MappingOutcome.VisitorBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing a Visitor with specified handler functions.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.OnError
classes.description: A functional interface for handling error outcomes during message mapping.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.MappedOutcome
classes.description: Implementation of MappingOutcome representing a successful mapped message.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.DroppedOutcome
classes.description: Implementation of MappingOutcome representing a dropped message.

classes.name: MappingOutcome.ErrorOutcome
classes.description: Implementation of MappingOutcome representing an error in message mapping.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to evaluate the mapping outcome.

methods.name: mapped
methods.description: Creates a mapping outcome representing a successfully mapped message.

methods.name: dropped
methods.description: Creates a mapping outcome representing a dropped message.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Creates a mapping outcome representing an error during mapping.

methods.name: newVisitorBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a visitor to handle outcomes.
